license_scope_review_notes: The page and embedded GLB metadata identify Sketchfab Standard, which the approved B1 rule permits only for authorized local work, subject to custom terms and dependency rights.
custom_terms_review_notes: Sketchfab NoAI bars use with programs designed to generate new content; CreatedWithAI is the separate creation label. The present B1 ACT/Diffusion policies output robot actions, not generated media or 3D content, so NoAI alone does not establish a conflict for this limited use. This review does not authorize generative-content training or broader reuse.
duplicate_review_notes: The source UID and two-panel geometry differ from both accepted doors; selected GLB geometry fingerprint 58c17659e05ff5882faa20d6574887325405bcc215b64d602e513f192b6b6127 differs from their fingerprints.
local_dependency_review_notes: The selected local GLB keeps the original geometry buffer byte-for-byte but removes all nine embedded source images, texture and sampler references, and image buffer views. Six independently authored flat PBR colors replace the source materials. Inspect attempt 000002 confirms zero textures and no external dependency. This pass applies only to the selected derivative, not the original textured GLB/USDZ.
local_duplicate_review_notes: Inspect attempt 000002 reports 4722 triangles, 22 components and geometry fingerprint 58c17659e05ff5882faa20d6574887325405bcc215b64d602e513f192b6b6127, distinct from the two accepted door fingerprints fbe3626a5effe7faf794b90d2cc407cb03c5f6b12f45878aa3d884a32858cb20 and 0ed927caadd03f215e80048d3a0152a5612e843fcb2590d1fa2a37988024fd43.
local_visual_review_notes: Reviewed attempt 000009 front/rear RTX images: both recessed leaf panels, complete molded frame, both dark lever handles and source hinge hardware remain visible; the fitted gaps are explicit and the six flat local PBR materials render consistently. Original wood/metal images are absent; appearance diversity belongs to later approved Replicator materials.
